name: Residence Permit for Studies

requirements.blocker_text: Requires acceptance as a student at a Finnish higher-education or other educational institution, in studies leading to a degree or vocational qualification.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain admission from a Finnish educational institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Must have sufficient funds for the entire validity period of the permit, and the ability to pay tuition fees where applicable.
Must hold private insurance covering medical and pharmaceutical expenses for the duration of study.

outcome.duration_length: for the entire duration of studies

sources.title: Maahanmuuttovirasto -- Studying in Finland: residence permit for degree/vocational studies, funds and insurance requirements, up to 30 hours/week (~1,560 hours/year) work rights during studies, post-graduation job-seeking permit

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Finland). work_rights modeled 'restricted' reflecting the stated cap of an average 30 hours/week (~1,560 hours/year), uncapped for required internships/diploma work credited toward the degree. A separate post-graduation 'residence permit to look for work' exists per the source but its specific duration was not confirmed at tier-1 precision in this pass; not modeled as a distinct route. family_can_join modeled false: no student-specific family reunification provision was located in this pass -- family reunification generally requires the sponsor to hold a continuous (A) or permanent permit (see fi_family_reunification.json).
